ValidationRule.description: Before an Opportunity can move to Proposed: Legal must have reviewed it Finance must have reviewed it The SOW must be Delivered
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Propose"), OR( NOT(SOW_Delivered__c), NOT(Legal_Reviewed__c), NOT(Finance_Reviewed__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before moving this Opportunity to Propose, Legal and Finance must review the SOW and it must be marked delivered.
